unit: lines of Rust in kernel/src, without blank lines and comments, both architectures (scripts/kernel_budget.py)

raised.why: the first budget (850-KRN-0145): the measured size and about 10% of room; a raise is a commit of its own that names the mechanism and why it cannot live in user space (MC-1.2)

000-KRN-0104: the derivation tree's index and revocation in steps (kernel/src/scheduler/tree.rs, about 200 lines): which capability derives from which is the kernel's own state (MC-3.3), so the walk that bounds a revocation (MC-5.4) cannot live in user space

100000-KRN-0171 (about 70 lines in kernel/src; the table itself is common/nodes.rs, outside it): the platform nodes' table, built from the device tree or the firmware's tables, and the checks of PLATFORM_MMIO and PLATFORM_NODE_IRQ. Which registers and lines a task may hold is the kernel's grant (MC-3.1, MC-3.3), and the check that a page holds no other device's registers, no RAM and none the kernel drives needs the kernel's view of all of them, so it cannot live in user space. 000-KRN-0220 (10 lines): each CPU turning its caches on and its CR0 recorded are processor state only the kernel sets. 7320 lines after both; about 80 of room.
